date_scope_check.qualification_retained: SC25-D1: Formal partial-access endpoint April 17, 2018, not unrestricted all-day operation. Actu Cameroun dates closure December 28, 2017; the wider December 24–28 onset bound is retained pending reconciliation, and December 24 is also the reported coup-attempt date in other sources. Actual movement is independently documented by VOA on June 5/6, 2018. January 26, 2019 reported barrier removal is a later milestone, not the first passage after an uninterrupted year. Initial exemptions and exact first April passage remain unknown.
